description: 한국수자원공사_다목적댐 운영 정보 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국수자원공사. ㅁ 개 요: K-water에서 관리중인 다목적댐 운영정보 ㅁ 제공항목: 강우량(mm), 유입량(㎥/sec), 방류량(㎥/sec), 저수위(EL. m), 저수량(백만㎥), 저수율(%. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국수자원공사. Its tags are 댐, 다목적댐, 운영, 저수량, 저수율. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-08-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
